name: kindroid-mcp-server
description: Connect Claude to the Kindroid AI platform to interact with your Kindroid AI companions (Kins).

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a Kindroid AI and receive its response. Optionally attach images, video, or links.

tools.name: create_kin
tools.description: Create a new Kindroid AI companion (Kin). Requires a name, gender, and backstory.

tools.name: update_kin
tools.description: Update a Kindroid AI companion's profile fields such as backstory, memories, directives, and avatar settings.

tools.name: request_selfie
tools.description: Request a solo selfie image of a single Kindroid AI companion.

tools.name: request_group_selfie
tools.description: Request a group selfie image featuring multiple Kindroid AI companions (up to 3 participants).

tools.name: chat_break
tools.description: Start a new conversation with a Kindroid AI, clearing the previous chat context.

tools.name: check_subscription
tools.description: Check the current Kindroid account subscription status.

tools.name: create_journal_entry
tools.description: Create a journal entry for a Kin with key phrases for contextual recall during conversation.

tools.name: create_groupchat
tools.description: Create a new group chat with multiple Kindroid AI companions.

tools.name: update_groupchat
tools.description: Update a group chat's settings such as name, context, directive, and participant list.

tools.name: send_groupchat_message
tools.description: Send a user message to a group chat with multiple Kindroid AI companions.

tools.name: groupchat_get_turn
tools.description: Determine which Kin should respond next in a group chat.

tools.name: groupchat_ai_response
tools.description: Request a specific Kin to respond in a group chat. Returns the response text.

tools.name: suggest_user_message
tools.description: Get a suggested message for the user to send to a Kindroid AI.

tools.name: suggest_user_group_message
tools.description: Get a suggested message for the user to send in a group chat.

tools.name: update_user_profile
tools.description: Update the authenticated user's profile fields or set the active persona.

tools.name: get_chat_messages
tools.description: Retrieve chat history for a Kin or group chat, oldest first, with cursor pagination.

tools.name: rewind_messages
tools.description: Remove the most recent messages from a Kin's solo chat or a group chat (an undo).

tools.name: groupchat_chat_break
tools.description: Start a new conversation in a group chat, resetting short-term memory with a required greeting.

api_key.title: Kindroid API Key
api_key.description: Your API key from the Kindroid platform (find it at kindroid.ai under Settings > API)
